'''Force smell''' was a [[Force power/Legends|Force power]] that allowed the user to augment their sense of smell, in order to pick up things that they normally would be unable to. [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] used it to smell the faint odor from [[Niles Ferrier]]'s [[Cigarra/Legends|cigarra]]<ref>''[[Dark Force Rising]]''</ref> and years later to catch the scents of the other refugees in the ''[[Eye of Palpatine]]''.
